subject: Online in Burnout 2
author: Xandu
body:
The only online functionality in Burnout 2: Point of Impact is the online leaderboards. So no, you do not need to be online to play the game. For some strange reason we didn't even have to get an update to play the game but that might be because we played Burnout 3: Takedown on the same XBox a couple of days ago.

-- The Creator --
